overview.en:
Analyze private-capital GP portfolios, operating performance, valuations, fund reviews, company reports, and TVPI attribution through Chronograph's official skills and hosted OAuth MCP.

Analyze private-capital portfolios using the connected fund data. Fix the reporting date and portfolio scope before comparing exposures, cash flows, or performance measures.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
分析私募资本投资组合、经营表现、估值与基金回报归因。

利用已连接基金数据分析私募资本投资组合，先固定报告日期和组合范围，再比较风险敞口、现金流或业绩指标。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Summarize this portfolio as of the selected reporting date.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 按选定报告日期汇总这个投资组合。

starterPrompts.en: Compare the available performance measures for these funds.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 比较这些基金的可用业绩指标。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare an investment committee brief highlighting portfolio changes.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 准备一份投资委员会简报，重点说明组合变化。

descriptions.en: Compare portfolio company operating actuals against budget/plan, compute variances, flag off-plan companies, and roll up to the fund, using Chronograph company metrics.
Generate a consolidated quarterly review pack for a single fund — a fund-level summary plus a one-pager section for every portfolio company in the fund — using Chronograph data.
Route end-to-end Chronograph GP portfolio and fund analysis across the official GP workflow skills.
Identify which portfolio companies were marked up or down this period, quantify each change, surface the stated basis, and rank by impact on fund NAV — using Chronograph investment metrics.

Generate one-pagers and investor reports for private equity portfolio companies. Handles live data fetching via the Chronograph MCP OR an uploaded Excel model, metric formatting, AI-generated or model-sourced commentary, and rendering a fully styled HTML one-pager.
Decompose a fund's total value / TVPI into per-company contributions, split realized vs. unrealized, and rank top contributors and detractors — using Chronograph investment metrics.
